name: New York
agency: Local Department of Social Services (HRA in New York City)

period.description: Your spenddown is figured one month at a time, but you can meet several months at once (up to six) with enough bills or a pay-in.

submission.description: Bring, mail or fax your bills to your local Medicaid office (in NYC, fax to the HRA Surplus Unit with form MAP-931y). Or use the Pay-In program and pay the spenddown to the office, up to six months at a time.

notes: Unpaid bills you still owe can count, even old ones, as long as the provider can still collect them.
You still owe your providers the part of the bills used to meet your spenddown.
Hospital stays: you must meet six months' worth of spenddown before Medicaid pays an inpatient bill.
For applications from January 2027, federal law cuts retroactive coverage for age 65+, blind and disabled to two months.
